The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] '''ST2 concussion missile''' was a type of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] armament installed in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Description==
[[File:ST2_missile_launch.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] fires two ST2 missiles into the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] main reactor.]]
ST2 concussion missiles were launched from [[ST2 concussion missile tube/Legends|ST2 concussion missile racks]], each of which could carry four [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. An ST2 missile was just over one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long and was as powerful as a standard [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]].<ref name="EGWT" /> They had an optimum range of 300 meters and a maximum range of 700 meters,<ref name="NEGWT" /> and cost 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] apiece.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
Using two of these missiles, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] breached the reactor core of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], delivering the killing blow to the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. They were later used in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] during the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] attacked the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] and fired two missiles at its command tower, killing  [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].
